movie.title: Signal One
movie.overview: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When computer scientist Annika Kask is recruited to a remote Caribbean island to study extraterrestrial matter, the team's attempt to contact an alien intelligence triggers global chaos and leaves humanity questioning if the entities come in peace.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Computer scientist Annika Kask is recruited by charismatic billionaire Sam Houston to a secret facility on a Caribbean island to examine extraterrestrial matter on Earth. Working alongside engineer Charlie Kaminsky and physicist Dr. Perry Glassner, she discovers a quantum communication device designed to interact with alien life. When the team ignores Annika's warnings and transmits a reply into space, atmospheric chaos and global power disruptions erupt. Forced to face the unknown, humanity is left to confront whether the entity on the other end comes in peace or poses an existential threat.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Computer scientist Annika Kask is recruited by solar energy billionaire Sam Houston to join a high-tech private research facility on a remote Caribbean island. Upon arrival, Annika discovers she was hired alongside electronics engineer Charlie Kaminsky to assist Dr. Perry Glassner, an eccentric physicist who has built a quantum communication device called Littlemouth. Glassner reveals that extraterrestrial matter is already present on Earth and that his machine has intercepted a mysterious signal originating beyond our world. Annika is brought on to provide moral oversight and evaluate potential risks, while Charlie works to calibrate the experimental transmission technology. Despite Annika’s strong warnings regarding the ethical and existential dangers of contacting an unknown species, Charlie and Dr. Glassner decide to send a reply back into the cosmos. The decision immediately triggers global disruptions, including local power blackouts and a terrifying sky anomaly that rapidly expands over the island. Tensions boil over as Sam Houston's hubris and obsession with legacy drive him to keep pushing the experiment forward despite the mounting chaos. As atmospheric phenomena intensify and systems fail, Annika must confront her own personal grief while trying to stop the facility from bringing cosmic destruction upon Earth. The team realizes too late that attempting to initiate contact with an unvetted alien intelligence carries severe consequences for the future of humanity.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Signal One is a sci-fi mystery drama following visionary computer scientist Annika Kask, who is recruited by solar tech billionaire Sam Houston to a secretive research outpost on a remote Caribbean island. Joined by high-profile electronics engineer Charlie Kaminsky and reclusive physicist Dr. Perry Glassner, Annika learns that extraterrestrial matter exists on Earth and that Glassner's quantum transmitter, 'Littlemouth,' has intercepted a signal from deep space. As the team debates the ethical, scientific, and philosophical implications of sending a response, ambition clashes with moral caution, plunging the island and the planet into uncharted peril.

story_structure.climax: A critical breakthrough in the transmission triggers a catastrophic event across the island, forcing the scientist to make a split-second decision as humanity's first true contact hangs in the balance.
story_structure.conflict: Initial investigations reveal the alien matter is actively trying to communicate, forcing the team to grapple with the unknown intentions of an off-world intelligence and the billionaire's secretive motives.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the chaos, the surviving team must face the world-altering reality of what was invited onto Earth, leaving the true nature of the visitors lingering in uncertainty.
story_structure.introduction: A brilliant computer scientist is recruited by an enigmatic tech billionaire to travel to a secluded Caribbean island facility and analyze mysterious extraterrestrial matter.
story_structure.risingAction: As contact is established, strange phenomena escalate within the facility, paranoia spreads among the staff, and isolated containment breaches threaten to spiral out of control.
